name: stats
js: (() => { const C = window.CITY, p = C.patioStats || {}, k = C.parkedStats || {}; const bw = (p.sites || []).filter((s) => s.kind === 'curb' && s.bikeway > 0).map((s) => s.address + ' ' + s.bikeway); const out = { patios: { layout: p.layout, fingerprint: p.fingerprint, placed: p.placed, rejected: p.rejected, inBikeway: bw, laneConflicts: p.laneConflicts && p.laneConflicts.length }, detours: C.bikeDetourStats || null, parked: { kept: k.kept, laneDropped: k.laneDropped, laneDroppedBy: k.laneDroppedBy, patioDropped: k.patioDropped, source: k.source && { stalls: k.source.stalls, cars: k.source.cars } }, q: location.search }; console.log('[ride-check] danforth ' + JSON.stringify(out)); if (p.fingerprint && !p.fingerprint.ok) throw new Error('The prebuilt patio layout is stale: ' + JSON.stringify(p.fingerprint)); if (p.laneConflicts && p.laneConflicts.length) throw new Error('A curb lane platform in a traffic lane: ' + JSON.stringify(p.laneConflicts.slice(0, 5))); return out; })()

name: danforth-494-aerial
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP; app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [3485.22, 30, -2770.04], look: [3485.22, 0, -2771.04], fov: 50 }); const s = (window.CITY.patioStats.sites || []).find((p) => p.address === "494 DANFORTH AVE" && p.kind === 'curb'); console.log('[ride-check] danforth-494 ' + JSON.stringify(s ? { id: s.id, x: +s.cx.toFixed(2), z: +s.cz.toFixed(2), length: s.length, bikeway: s.bikeway } : 'not placed')); })()
